title: feat(ui-kit): a camcraft-ui-kit crate for the design system (tokens, theme files, contrast checks, gallery)
body:
Part of #4245 (step 0, PR K). This PR merges after PR R (#4393). The maintainer merges it: it adds a new crate edge and changes the workspace manifest.

Process change: yes

## What changed

- A new crate `crates/ui-kit` (`camcraft-ui-kit`). It depends on `egui` (`=0.36.2`, the workspace pin) and `serde_json` only. It has no `camcraft-*` dependency.
- These modules move from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/` into the kit. Their behaviour does not change:
  - `theme` (the `Tokens` table, `DARK`, `LIGHT`, `clamp`, `DropGeom`, `visuals`, `style`, `apply_to`, `ribbon_h`, `status_h`, the exhaustiveness guard);
  - `theme_files` (the `camcraft-theme/1` reader, the caps, the cache, `COLOR_NAMES`, `GEOM_NAMES`);
  - `contrast` (the WCAG arithmetic, the follow law, the readability gate), plus `light_ground` from `ground_ink`.
- The kit has its own `ThemeSource` enum and `resolve_source`, because it cannot see `camcraft_app::schema::ThemeRef`.
- `crates/ui` keeps the old module paths as re-exports: `egui_app::contrast`, `egui_app::theme::*`, `egui_app::theme_files::*` and `ground_ink::light_ground`. No other file of `crates/ui` changes, so the open UI PRs keep their paths. `panes.rs` is not touched.
- `crates/ui` keeps two things, and the decision entry gives the reasons:
  - the live theme cell (`current`, `set_current`, `apply`) and its tests, because its thread-local test form uses `#[cfg(test)]`, which applies per crate (#2373);
  - `theme_files::resolve(&mut Cache, &ThemeRef)`, which maps `ThemeRef` onto the kit's `ThemeSource`.
- A gallery page `camcraft_ui_kit::gallery`: widgets, the readability pairs, every colour token and every geometry token, for the dark and the light theme. The two token listings destructure `Tokens` without `..`, so a new token that the gallery does not show does not compile. The look follows the #4245 rules: a flat frame, a hairline, no shadow, a small radius, section headers from type.
- A gallery window `ui-kit-gallery` behind the feature `gallery`: `cargo run -p camcraft-ui-kit --features gallery --bin ui-kit-gallery`. `cargo test -p camcraft-ui-kit` does not build it.
- The decision entry `docs/decisions/4394-ui-kit-crate.md` for the edge `ui -> ui-kit`: the imported items, why the caller cannot pass them in, and what rebuilds.
- The colour-literal guard of `crates/ui` (`tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs`) loses the rows of `contrast.rs` and `theme/tables.rs`, because these files are no longer in that crate.

## Gate crate lists (xtask, process file)

The gate does not discover crates. `xtask/src/plan.rs` has fixed lists. Without an entry, a diff in `crates/ui-kit` selects no test and no clippy run. This PR adds `ui-kit` to `ALL_CRATES`, `BATCH_CRATES` and `CLIPPY`, before `ui` (dependency order). Two xtask tests follow the new crate: `reach_follows_the_crate_dependencies` (the kernel does not reach `ui-kit`; `ui-kit` reaches `ui`) and the batch prebuild fixture in `step_tests.rs` (it writes a manifest for `ui-kit`). The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

## Dependency tree of the kit

`cargo tree -p camcraft-ui-kit -e normal,dev` (no feature): 58 crates, with no flecs, no `camcraft-*` crate, no wgpu, no winit and no eframe.

```
camcraft-ui-kit v0.27.0
├── egui v0.36.2
│   ├── accesskit, ahash, bitflags, emath, epaint, itertools, log,
│   └── nohash-hasher, profiling, smallvec, unicode-segmentation
└── serde_json v1.0.154
    └── itoa, memchr, serde_core, zmij
```

`Cargo.lock` adds only the `camcraft-ui-kit` package and its edge from `camcraft-ui`. There is no new third-party crate (`eframe` and `winit` are already in the lock).

## Tests

Pinning tests:

- `crates/ui-kit/tests/contrast.rs`: `both_builtin_columns_clear_their_own_gate`, `the_follow_law_round_trips_and_translates`, `an_accent_only_file_derives_its_family_and_says_so`, `unreadable_files_refuse_by_name` (moved unchanged).
- `crates/ui-kit/tests/gallery.rs`: `the_gallery_lists_each_token_once_by_its_file_name`, `hex_spells_colours_the_way_a_theme_file_does`, `the_reading_pairs_clear_their_floors_on_both_builtins`, `both_themes_lay_out_in_a_headless_context`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme_files/resolve_tests.rs`: `builtin_references_land_their_compiled_columns`, `a_stranger_name_refuses_by_name`, `a_file_reference_reads_through_the_kit_cache`, `the_old_paths_name_the_kit_items`.

Gate results on the final head `40e5d5d` (it includes a second merge of `origin/main` at `e4b08e9`, see "Merge of main"):

| Head | Lane | Step | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `40e5d5d` | mac-1 | `cargo xtask gate batch --only "debug build: ui" --only ui`: 32 steps (both builds, 3 ui-kit suites, all 29 ui suites including `ui suites: lib`) | 32 ok, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `40e5d5d` | mac-1 | `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui-kit -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | ok |
| `40e5d5d` | mac-1 | `cargo test -p xtask` | ok |

Earlier heads: `376104a` had the same steps green (batch and clippy on winbuild, xtask on mac-1), plus `cargo build -p camcraft-ui-kit --features gallery --bin ui-kit-gallery` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui-kit -p xtask --all-targets --features camcraft-ui-kit/gallery -- -D warnings`. `c518ffe` had the same 32 steps green on winbuild.

The official `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` falls back to batch, because the diff touches `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`. The runs above are the batch steps of the crates that this diff reaches. The winbuild plan shows that the gate finds the new crate: it has the steps `debug build: ui-kit` and `ui-kit suites: *`.

Not run: the batch steps of the engine crates and `camcraft-app` test binaries. The diff does not change these crates; `Cargo.lock` only adds the kit. The full builder run stopped at the full disk. No example catalog suite is required (no post or toolpath change). The light lane was not run (no heavy test is touched).

## Merge of main

First merge (`376104a`): `origin/main` added 18 tool tokens to `Tokens` and `with_alpha` (#1120, `d3e8dd705`, `5d2c2b2d6`). The merge carries them into the kit: `theme.rs`, `tables.rs`, `legal.rs`, `names.rs` and `overlay.rs` of the kit have them, and the gallery listings show them (the destructure guard asked for that). The new `theme/verdict.rs` stays in `crates/ui`: it holds impls on the shell types `Semantic` and `TextInks`. `ground_ink.rs` and the colour-literal rows take main's version with the change of this PR.

Second merge (`40e5d5d`): `origin/main` added the window close inks `close_hover` and `close_ink` (#1120 window chrome, `c859c79eb`).
- Git carried the new rows of `tables.rs`, `legal.rs`, `names.rs` and `overlay.rs` into the kit copies by rename detection.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs` keeps the re-export seam of this PR. The two fields go into the `Tokens` struct and the `apply_to` destructure of `crates/ui-kit/src/theme.rs`.
- The three gallery listings in `crates/ui-kit/src/gallery/rows.rs` name the two new tokens.
- `crates/ui/tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs` takes the list of main, minus the rows of the files that moved to the kit (`contrast.rs`, `theme/tables.rs`). Main removed the `error_text.rs` and `window_chrome.rs` rows, so they are gone here too.
- The new test `crates/ui/tests/theme_files/chrome_inks.rs` of main stays in `crates/ui`. It reads `Tokens` through the re-export.

## Test counts

- `origin/main` at `e4b08e9`: 1984 `#[test]` in `crates/ui`.
- This head: 1984 in `crates/ui` and 8 in `crates/ui-kit`, 1992 in total. Four contrast tests move to the kit. The PR adds 8 tests: four seam tests (`egui_app/theme_files/resolve_tests.rs`) and four gallery tests.

## Screenshots

This is a new page, so there is no "before". The images are a headless `egui_kittest` render of `gallery::show` and `gallery::show_theme` (a test file that is not committed). They are rendered again on `40e5d5d` and show the close inks.

Both themes, side by side:

![gallery, dark and light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/4397/gallery-both.png)

Dark only: ![gallery, dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/4397/gallery-dark.png)

Light only: ![gallery, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/4397/gallery-light.png)

## Not exercised

- The gallery window was built, but not opened by hand. The screenshots come from a headless `egui_kittest` render of the same `gallery::show` code.
- The wasm32 build of `crates/ui` was not built. The moved files have no wasm `cfg`, and the kit has no platform code.
- The full heavy lanes (not required at review).

Changelog: UI: the theme tokens, the theme-file reader and the contrast checks now live in a new crate `camcraft-ui-kit`, with a gallery of all tokens in the dark and the light theme (no visible change in the app).

Effort: high

Fixes #4394
